knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/malagasy_merge_master_v2.gt"))
```

This script repeats the steps in s01a_qc_merge to merge malagasy with global datasets, while retaining and ordering the genetic distance of SNPs, for ALDER analysis.

# Borneo

```{r}
if (file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Borneo_raw_data.gt"))) {
  borneo <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Borneo_raw_data.gt"))
} else {
  borneo <- gen_tibble(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Borneo_raw_data.bed"), valid_alleles = c("A", "T", "C", "G", "I", "N"), quiet = TRUE)
}

borneo$population <- "Borneo"
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/malagasy_borneo.gt"))) {
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/malagasy_borneo.gt"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/malagasy_borneo.bk"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/malagasy_borneo.rds"))
}
```

```{r}
malagasy_borneo <- rbind(malagasy_merged, borneo,
  as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE, backingfile = resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/malagasy_borneo")
)

```

# 1000 G

Cutting down to populations of interest

```{r}
if (file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/1000_Genomes_b37_clean.gt"))) {
  g1000 <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/1000_Genomes_b37_clean.gt"))
} else {
  g1000 <- gen_tibble(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/1000_Genomes_b37_clean.bed"), quiet = TRUE)
}

# append population info
pop_table <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable"), sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)
colnames(pop_table) <- c("IID", "V2", "FID", "Population", "V5", "V6", "V7")

pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table, pop_table$IID %in% g1000$id)

matching_m <- match(g1000$id, pop_table_sub$IID)
g1000$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), pop_table_sub$V2[matching_m], g1000$population)

pop <- c("KHV", "BEB", "YRI", "PJL", "GWD", "MSL", "ESN", "LWK", "CHS")
#- Kinh in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
#- Bengali in Bangladesh
#- Han Chinese South
#- Luhya in Webuye, Kenya
#- Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria
#- Punjabi in Lahore, Pakistan
#- Gambian in Western Division, The Gambia - Mandinka
#- Mende in Sierra Leone
#- Esan in Nigeria

g1000 <- g1000 %>% filter(population %in% pop)

count_loci(g1000)
nrow(g1000)
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000.gt"))) {
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000.gt"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000.bk"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000.rds"))
}

mad_bor_g1000 <- rbind(malagasy_borneo, g1000,
  as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE, backingfile = resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000")
)

```

# Sumba

```{r}
if (file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/GSE76645_INDONESIA_SUMBA_TIMOR.gt"))) {
  sumba <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/GSE76645_INDONESIA_SUMBA_TIMOR.gt"))
} else {
  sumba <- gen_tibble(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/GSE76645_INDONESIA_SUMBA_TIMOR.bed"), quiet = TRUE)
}

sumba$population <- "Sumba"

timor <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/timor"))
timor$population <- "Timor"

matching_m <- match(sumba$id, timor$V2)
sumba$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), timor$population[matching_m], sumba$population)

count_loci(sumba)
nrow(sumba)
```


```{r}
if (file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum.gt"))) {
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum.gt"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum.bk"))
  file.remove(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum.rds"))
}

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- rbind(mad_bor_g1000, sumba,
  as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE, backingfile = resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum")
)
```


# Filter the merged dataset

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
loci_report_m <- qc_report_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% ungroup()
```

# Loci

```{r}
to_keep <- which(loci_report_m$hwe_p > 0.01)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep))
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% select_loci_if(loci_missingness(genotypes) < 0.01)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% select_loci_if(loci_maf(genotypes) > 0.025)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% select_loci_if(show_loci(genotypes)$chromosome %in% c(1:22))
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

# Indiv

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m <- qc_report_indiv(mad_bor_g1000_sum, kings_threshold = 0.177)
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% ungroup()
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

```{r}
gt_save(mad_bor_g1000_sum, resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean"))
```
